prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high fidelity desktop web application screenshot for ToolDawn, an international collection of practical AI utilities. One complete straight-on screen, 1536x1024, no device frame. Direction A: crisp white search-first utility directory, charcoal text, emerald primary actions and small coral accents. Brand ToolDawn prominently visible top left. Compact top navigation: Tools, Favorites, History; right side language globe, avatar. Main content starts immediately with a restrained title 'ToolDawn' and a wide search field 'Search tools'. A horizontal filter row: All tools, Images, Writing, Everyday. Below, organized grid of six compact tool items with subtle borders, max 8px corner radii, generous readable typography: Background Remover, Photo Restyle, Food Analyzer, Text Polisher, Birthday Wishes, Image Compressor. Image tools include accurate bright photographic previews: product bottle before/after background removal, a small landscape photo, and a food plate. Writing tools show short realistic document snippets. A small recent activity table is visible in lower part. Quiet polished usable software aesthetic, consistent fine line icons, aligned grid, restrained compact headings. No oversized hero, no slogan, no explanatory feature prose, no decorative orbs or gradients, no purple or beige dominant palette, no cards nested in cards, no charts with fake statistics. Render sharp legible English UI text. This is a visual design proposal, not a promotional poster.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high fidelity front-facing desktop web app screenshot for ToolDawn at 1536x1024, no laptop or browser frame. Direction B: efficient productivity workspace with narrow white left sidebar and pale neutral gray main canvas, charcoal headings, cobalt blue actions with small green and amber status accents. ToolDawn brand large enough to recognize in top left sidebar. Sidebar links with neat familiar line icons: Overview, All tools, Favorites, History, Files; bottom Settings and user profile. Main top toolbar has breadcrumb 'Workspace / Overview', search icon, notification bell and compact avatar. Main page title 'ToolDawn' with compact right aligned 'All tools' action. Immediately show a horizontal row of recently used tool shortcuts. Main working area is an unframed split layout: left two thirds a compact grid of practical tools with small consistent icons, title and concise task labels, including Photo Restyle, Background Remover, Text Polisher, Food Analyzer, Birthday Wishes, Image Compressor; right third an activity list with small actual image thumbnails and document file entries with muted timestamps. Under tool grid, a recent files table with image thumbnails, filenames, tool, status and date columns. Use an actual bright portrait restyle before/after preview in one repeated tool item. Professional measured spacing, clear hierarchy, thin dividers, compact dense but readable layout, max 6px radius on repeated items, aligned controls. No marketing hero, no decorative visualizations or unsupported usage statistics, no nested cards, no huge text, no gradient background. Show polished natural English labels and a coherent usable product interface.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high fidelity desktop web application screenshot for ToolDawn, 1536x1024 straight-on interface without device frame. Direction C: visual creative toolbox with white background, black typography, electric green primary accent and small magenta secondary accents, clear real photographic image previews. Brand ToolDawn is a prominent 28px wordmark in a slim header, next to Tools and My creations; right side search, language and user avatar icons. Immediately below header show compact category tabs All, Image, Writing, Everyday, plus search field. Main central experience is an unframed 3-column editorial-style gallery of actual usable tools, with bright carefully framed image examples. First tool Background Remover shows a recognizable green skincare bottle original with tabletop background versus transparent checkerboard cutout. Second Photo Restyle shows same landscape as photograph and colorful painted version. Third Food Analyzer shows overhead lunch plate with tiny ingredient labels. Second row Text Polisher shows a readable short before/after text document, Birthday Wishes shows a tasteful real paper greeting card with flowers and short 'Happy Birthday' typography, Image Compressor shows landscape photo with compact file-size labels. Each repeated tool item has preview above a compact title and trailing arrow action, subtle separation, at most 6px border radius, no outer decorative page panel. A short 'Recent creations' strip begins at bottom with thumbnails. Mature friendly creative software, not marketing. Sharp accurate UI typography, aligned columns, generous but efficient spacing, restrained headings, no oversized hero or slogans, no abstract orbs, no purple-blue gradient, no dark atmospheric imagery. The product and tool outcomes are clear at first glance.
